# Base Game UI Chrome -- Base-Game Template Mod

This is a **base-game template mod**. Its contents are generated by the game
at startup and will be regenerated if the file set is incomplete or missing.

## Do not edit this mod directly.

Any changes you make to the files in this directory will be silently
overwritten the next time the game launches and validates its base-game
mod set. This protection exists to keep a stable reference copy that
other mods can build on top of.

## To customize this mod

Open the Mod Manager (Main Menu -> Mods -> Modding Hub) and use **Save As**
to create a user mod from this template. Your user mod will live in
`mods/user/<your-name>/` and is yours to edit freely.

## Why this exists

The base-game template system lets the game ship a default look and
feel that mods can descend from. The template is the canonical source;
user mods are editable copies. Keeping the two separated prevents
accidental overwrites of the baseline when the extractor runs again.
